verified_facts.text: From the east-facing windows of the Imperial Floor Suites you can see the distant ridgelines of the Ikoma mountain range and, below, the Okawa River.
verified_facts.excerpt: From windows facing east, you can see the distant ridgelines of the Ikoma mountain range, and from below, the majestic flow of the Okawa River.

verified_facts.text: The Regular Floor Suite has an open entrance, a separate parlor and bedroom, and a bath area lit by natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring an open entrance, separate parlor and bedroom, and a bright bath area flooded with natural light.

verified_facts.text: The Regular Floor Suite offers a 180-degree river view.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering a 180-degree river view.

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Floors, on floors 19 to 21, hold the hotel's highest-grade rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Imperial Floors, covering Floors 19 through to 21, contain our highest quality rooms.

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Floor Lounge is for the exclusive use of Imperial Floor guests and suite guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: For the exclusive use of Imperial Floor guests and Suite guests.

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Floor Junior Suites have a mist sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: The mist sauna, unique to the Junior Suites, offers a true relaxation time without the feeling of suffocation.

verified_facts.text: Regular Floor Superior rooms look down on the riverside nature, which changes with the seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can enjoy the beautiful nature along the river that changes with the seasons right below

verified_facts.text: Imperial Floor Deluxe rooms have the Imperial Hotel's original bed and duvet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a comfortable sleep with the Imperial Hotel's original bed and duvet

verified_facts.text: The fitness club has an open, resort-like interior with plenty of natural light and greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entering the lobby, guests are immersed in the club's open, resort-like interior with its abundance of natural light and greenery.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's facilities include a pool and saunas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a comfortable stay with our array of facilities including a pool, saunas, a members-only fitness club, and conference and meeting rooms.

verified_facts.text: The fitness club has tennis courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Tennis Courts**

verified_facts.text: The fitness club has a golf practice course.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Golf practice course**

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests pay an entrance fee to use the fitness club's pool, bath area and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entrance Fees (for guests staying at the hotel)

verified_facts.text: The fitness club cannot be used by persons with tattoos.
verified_facts.excerpt: intoxicated persons, and persons with tattoos.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center, pool and saunas close for maintenance on the third Tuesday of every month.
verified_facts.excerpt: Facilities are closed for maintenance on The 3rd Tuesday of every month

verified_facts.text: The concierge team has assembled programs ranging from traditional Japanese cultural experiences to sightseeing tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: From only-in-Japan traditional cultural experiences to sightseeing tours to delightful urban destinations, we have assembled a range of programs to suit your interests.

verified_facts.text: Concierge-recommended experiences include a traditional tea ceremony guided by a master.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Japan’s traditional tea ceremony right in the heart of Osaka. Guided by a master, you will learn the mindful ritual of preparing and enjoying authentic matcha green tea.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's restaurants and bar lounges serve French cuisine, a long tradition of the hotel, as well as Japanese, teppanyaki and Chinese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have restaurants and bar lounges offering different tastes, including French cuisine, a long tradition of the hotel, Japanese cuisine, teppanyaki cuisine, and Chinese cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Les Saisons, the fine French restaurant, is on the 23rd floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fine French Cuisine LES SAISONS (23F)

verified_facts.text: The hotel shop carries Doorman Snoopy goods, confectionery, breads and deli items.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel shop carries Doorman Snoopy goods to commemorate your stay, confectioneries, breads, and deli items.

verified_facts.text: The Imperial Hotel Plaza shopping arcade lies along the bank of the Okawa River, part of Osaka Amenity Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: This shopping plaza lies along the bank of the Okawa River, part of Osaka Amenity Park.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 8-50 Temmabashi 1-chome in Osaka's Kita-ku.
verified_facts.excerpt: 8-50, Temmabashi 1-Chome, Kita-ku, Osaka 530-0042, Japan

verified_facts.text: Ogimachi Station on the Osaka Metro Sakaisuji Line is about a 10-minute walk from Exit 4.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ogimachi Station | Osaka Metro Sakaisuji Line Approximately 10 minutes walk from Exit 4.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers barrier-free rooms partially modified for guests using wheelchairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer rooms that have been partially modified to make them more accessible for guests using wheelchairs.

verified_facts.text: In-room massage is among the services available to guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Internet, wake-up calls, and in-room massage are just some of the other services available to guests during their stay.

verified_facts.text: The hotel prepares services to make stays for wedding anniversaries, birthdays and other special occasions more memorable.
verified_facts.excerpt: We prepare various services to make your stay on a special day, including wedding anniversaries, birthdays, and other special occasions, even more memorable.

verified_facts.text: Imperial Floor Superior rooms have a night view of the city from the windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: The night view of the city from the windows will set the scene for your time before sleep.

verified_facts.text: The fitness club has a total floor area of 4,400 square meters.
